findings.issue: No comprehensive design token system — color tokens are ad-hoc CSS variables mixed with raw Tailwind values
findings.impact: Inconsistent colors, spacing, and typography across components; theme changes require per-component edits
findings.fix: Define complete token architecture: --color-*, --spacing-*, --radius-*, --shadow-*, --font-*, --opacity-* tokens in globals.css. Replace all raw Tailwind values with token references.

findings.issue: No semantic color system — colors are named by visual property (--color-blue-500) instead of semantic purpose (--color-link-primary)
findings.impact: Theme changes require updating every blue shade rather than just remapping semantic tokens; inconsistent color application
findings.fix: Define semantic color tokens: --color-bg-primary, --color-bg-secondary, --color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-link, --color-brand, --color-danger, --color-success, --color-warning, --color-border. Map to theme-specific values.

findings.issue: No typography system — text sizing uses ad-hoc Tailwind classes (text-sm, text-base, text-lg, text-2xl, text-3xl) with no design scale
findings.impact: Inconsistent text sizing across pages; no design system guardrails for heading hierarchy
findings.fix: Define typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32/40px with corresponding line-heights. Create Text and Heading components wrapping tailwind-merge for consistent usage.

findings.issue: No density/spacing model — spacing values are scattered as raw Tailwind classes (p-2, p-3, p-4, gap-2, gap-4) with no semantic mapping
findings.impact: Inconsistent component spacing; layout density changes require per-component edits rather than global token adjustment
findings.fix: Define spacing scale: --spacing-xs (4px), --spacing-sm (8px), --spacing-md (16px), --spacing-lg (24px), --spacing-xl (32px). Map to semantic contexts: --spacing-inset, --spacing-stack, --spacing-inline.

findings.issue: Only 2 themes (light/dark) with limited token coverage — no Slate Dark, OLED High-Contrast, or system-level theme inheritance
findings.impact: Theme expansion requires rewriting all tokens; no graceful system-preference fallback
findings.fix: Implement multi-theme architecture: .theme-light, .theme-dark-slate, .theme-dark-oled CSS classes with complete token sets. Add theme inheritance (system -> preferred -> default). SSR-safe hydration.

findings.issue: Primitive components (Button, Input, Dialog) lack state-style coverage — no disabled, error, loading, or focused states for all variants
findings.impact: Components show inconsistent disabled/error/loading visuals; accessibility gaps in state announcement
findings.fix: Add explicit state styles to each primitive: :disabled, :focus-visible, :invalid, [aria-invalid], .loading state with spinner. Use tailwind-merge for composed class names.

findings.issue: No motion system — animations use raw @keyframes with no timing tokens, easing curves, or duration scale
findings.impact: Inconsistent animation durations and easing; no design system for motion
findings.fix: Define motion tokens: --duration-fast (150ms), --duration-normal (250ms), --duration-slow (400ms); --easing-in, --easing-out, --easing-in-out. Apply consistently to transitions and animations.

findings.issue: Background colors use raw opacity values (opacity-50, opacity-70) instead of semantic overlay tokens
findings.impact: Opacity stacking creates unpredictable colors; theme changes break overlay colors
findings.fix: Define overlay tokens: --color-overlay-subtle, --color-overlay-hover, --color-overlay-active with proper alpha values instead of tailwind opacity classes

findings.issue: Button component supports only primary/secondary/ghost variants — no danger, success, or warning semantic variants
findings.impact: Destructive actions use manual danger styling; no consistent semantic button pattern
findings.fix: Add danger (red), success (green), and warning (amber) variants to Button component with proper hover/focus/disabled states

findings.issue: No focus styling token — focus-visible rings use hardcoded classes (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500)
findings.impact: Focus ring color/style changes require per-component edits; inconsistent focus visibility across themes
findings.fix: Define --color-focus-ring token; create .focus-ring utility class; ensure all interactive elements use it

findings.issue: No reduced-motion token — prefers-reduced-motion not checked, animations play unconditionally
findings.impact: Users with motion sensitivity get distracting animations
findings.fix: Add --motion-reduced boolean; wrap non-essential animations in prefers-reduced-motion: reduce @media query

findings.issue: No shadow/elevation token system — box-shadow values are ad-hoc across components
findings.impact: Inconsistent elevation styling; no design system for visual hierarchy

findings.issue: No compact/comfortable/spacious density mode — layout density is fixed
findings.impact: Users cannot adjust information density, especially in message list
findings.fix: Add density CSS variable (--density) with compact/comfortable/spacious values; adjust padding, margins, and font sizes proportionally

findings.issue: No design token documentation — tokens exist only in CSS files with no reference or usage guide
findings.impact: Developers cannot discover available tokens; inconsistent token usage across codebase
findings.fix: Create DESIGN_TOKENS.md documenting all tokens with examples; add token usage lint rule
